_comment: Grandfathered `*-card` class BLOCKS that are deliberately NOT rendered on a BDS <Card>. Read by scripts/lint-card-class.mjs (brikdesigns#1260). Each entry carries its reason, because that is the whole point of the list — an unexplained name here is indistinguishable from unpaid debt. The gate ratchets both ways: adding an unbacked card without an entry fails, and leaving an entry for a name that has since been converted or deleted also fails. Only ever remove entries; adding one needs a reason a reviewer would accept, not 'it was easier'. NOTE: renaming a thing so it stops claiming to be a card is a legitimate way to leave this list — `contact-card` and `about-team-card` left that way in #1260 (they became `contact-panel` and `about-team-member`), and the reverse-ratchet is what forced their entries to be dropped in the same commit. 7 entries at gate install, 5 now.

allowed.card-grid-block: The layout wrapper (optional centered header + the grid) for the `card-grid` landing block (CardGridBlock.tsx). Not itself a card — a flex column with no fill or chrome. The real cards are `.card-grid__card`, rendered on a BDS <Card> and reached by the 'Card chrome by band' rule. Mirrors `plans-card-wrapper` (a grid-cell wrapper around the actual card).
allowed.cta-card-brand: The shared brand CTA panel (a Section-level band child on /about, /blog, /blog/[slug], /how-we-work, /industries/[slug], /results, /results/[slug]). Fixed brand-orange fill, no card chrome to inherit. Already the ONE such panel — it absorbed the /blog-only `.cta-card` twin in #1260. Kept its name: unlike `contact-panel` / `about-team-member` it IS a card-shaped object (a bounded, rounded, filled block inside a band), just not a BDS one.
allowed.hiw-card: A semantic <article> process step on /how-we-work, with a two-pane internal layout (content + checklist pane) that the Card content slot does not model. BDS Card renders a <div> or an <a> and exposes no `as` prop, so converting would trade correct document semantics for shared chrome.
allowed.plans-card-wrapper: A layout wrapper around a BDS <PricingCard> plus its illustration — the media sits OUTSIDE the pricing card by design (PlanCardGrid.tsx). The card in this composition is the PricingCard; the wrapper is the grid cell.
allowed.services-card-link: A Next.js <Link> wrapping the real BDS <Card> (`services-card`) so the whole cell navigates. Chrome lives on the inner Card; this carries only display/text-decoration/height. Correct as-is.
allowed.value-card: A numbered pillar tile on /value — an icon + number + title in a fixed four-color set, sized and spaced as a nav pillar rather than a content card. No card chrome to inherit; the colored fill IS the affordance.
